title: TASK-012 검증 증거 갱신과 closeout
summary: TASK-012의 홈(`/`)과 제작(`/create`) 분리 구현은 보존하되, goal evaluator가 지적한 dirty/untracked 상태와 부족한 최신 검증 증거를 해소한다. 로컬 checks, runtime/browser smoke, review/eval/context artifact를 갱신한 뒤 commit/push까지 완료한다.
deliverables: local runtime evidence for `/` and `/create` on the configured dev server
browser smoke evidence for upload -> preset -> generate real or mock -> result -> download/copy prompt
commit containing TASK-012 and TASK-013 evidence
acceptance: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm build` are rerun after the post-`/create` split and their fresh results are recorded without contradiction.
The local app runs on the configured dev server and `/` renders as the premium product/home page while `/create` owns upload, preset, mode, generate, result, download, and copy prompt actions.
A browser smoke covers upload -> preset -> generate real or mock -> result -> download/copy prompt after TASK-012, with mock fallback evidence if OPENAI_API_KEY or model access is unavailable.
Review, release-readiness, precomplete eval, log, and compressed context artifacts no longer claim stale generator-first-home evidence and instead describe the home/create split accurately.
Git status is reconciled so TASK-012 source changes, TASK-013 task graph updates, and evidence artifacts are committed on `feature/memecast-mvp` without secrets or private uploaded images.
Push to `origin/feature/memecast-mvp` succeeds, or a concrete auth/network blocker is recorded before any completion claim.
Only after the evaluator no longer reports dirty/unpushed state or missing fresh build/runtime/browser evidence may the loop emit COMPLETE.
modeContract: implementation: COMPLETE requires fresh checks, runtime/browser smoke evidence, updated review/eval/context artifacts, and clean committed/pushed task graph state.
designContract: Preset apple-like-premium-product, reference pack apple-like-clean-product-ui. `/` remains a product/home page for tone, modes, scenarios, and examples; `/create` remains the only upload and generation flow. Reference pack file is absent, so DESIGN.md is the active design gate.
evaluatorReason: The post-`/create` split is present in the worktree, but it is uncommitted/unpushed and lacks fresh build/runtime/browser evidence.
